description: Source code for the internal storage handling of memory change events in a system, including methods for storing, retrieving, and cleaning up events in both BoltDB and PostgreSQL databases.

methods.name: StoreEvent
methods.description: Saves a memory change event to the database, handling both Postgres and BoltDB modes, with concurrency control for cleanup routines.

methods.name: startEventCleanup
methods.description: Starts a background cleanup routine that periodically deletes expired events based on TTL.

methods.name: cleanupExpiredEvents
methods.description: Removes events older than the default TTL from a BoltDB database.

methods.name: GetEventHistory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of memory change events based on specified filters, with support for both BoltDB and Postgres.

methods.name: storeEventPostgres
methods.description: Handles storing a memory change event into a Postgres database, including capturing the generated ID.

methods.name: cleanupExpiredEventsPostgres
methods.description: Deletes expired events from the Postgres database based on TTL.

methods.name: getEventHistoryPostgres
methods.description: Queries the Postgres database for events matching provided filters, including pattern matching and limits.
